THE PIPING HAS BEEN CORRECTED AND SEALED AND ALL APPROPRIATE MEASURES TAKEN TO AVOID FUTURE INCIDENTS.

properties.content:

Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: UNITED WATER (IDAHO)
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.617170, -116.218602 (Approximated from route)
Report Description
//////WEB REPORT///// REPORTABLE QUANTITY OF SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE WAS LEAKED THROUGH A SMALL CHEMICAL BACKPRESSURE VALVE AT A WELL HOUSE LOCATED AT 3651 AMERICANA BLVD., BOISE, IDAHO. THE AMOUNT WAS APPROXIMATELY 125-150 POUNDS AS SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE. IT WAS SPILLED SLOWLY THROUGH A LEAKING VALVE OVER A THREE DAY PERIOD AND SOME OF IT LEFT THE WELL BUILDING, SOAKED INTO THE GROUND AROUND IT AND IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SOME AMOUNT ENTERED A NEARBY WATERWAY. THE INCIDENT IS OVER AND THERE IS NO THREAT TO THE PUBLIC.
